environment.broker_distribution: four independent Solace PubSub+ Standard containers
environment.protocol: native guaranteed SMF plaintext over loopback
environment.topology: one active plus three pre-provisioned warm standalone brokers

measurement_scope: bounded reduced-threshold functional automatic 1-to-4 scale-out using real monotonic time, real queue/VPN telemetry and Controller.tick; not broker capacity, HA failover, Cloud provisioning or production qualification
behaviors: production KeyRouter mapped business keys across all 12 partitions
two identical wildcard groups each received every accepted event exactly once
Controller.tick selected all three migrations without manual assignment changes
each warm target became active in durable state before handover
every source drained and remained ingress-disabled after atomic ownership commit
post-cutover traffic reached every current owner, including final broker d
limitations: The capacity profile and thresholds are invented solely to trigger a bounded functional decision; they are not measured broker capacity.
Warm entries represent independent standalone Standard containers, not HA mates or Cloud services.
The run did not create Cloud capacity, exercise scale-in, test HA/DR, establish saturation, or perform a soak.
Restart recovery remains covered by separate migration tests rather than this sequential run.
Publishing paused during each handover; post-cutover bursts prove resumed routing, not uninterrupted publishing through sustained overload.
